summary: Firefox’s CSS style system became more consistent and robust, with many properties moved to shared predefined representations and better handling of computed colors, variation settings, CSSOM exposure, and pref-controlled features. It also fixes edge cases involving CSS zoom, text boxes, fieldsets, blending, masks, and scrolling, while adding the `grid-lanes` value for `display` and recognizing `plus-lighter` for `background-blend-mode`. _Most of this is behind-the-scenes work that improves correctness and maintainability, rather than a visible redesign._
